note: Part 1 of the catalogue: Blob, Data Lake Gen2, Files, Queue and Table storage.

types.label: Blob Storage (block blob)
types.note: Capacity, write and read operations and data retrieval per tier and redundancy. Early-deletion fees, index tags, lifecycle management, inventory, priority retrieval and archive rehydration are not included.

inputs.label: Write operations
inputs.help: Write operations per month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Read operations
inputs.help: Read operations per month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Data retrieval
inputs.help: Data read back from Cool, Cold or Archive per month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and armRegionName eq '{region}' and productName eq 'General Block Blob v2'

retrieval.free: No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.
No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.
No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.
No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.

types.label: Data Lake Storage Gen2 (hierarchical namespace)
types.note: Block blob storage with a hierarchical namespace. Capacity, write and read operations and data retrieval; iterative operations, query acceleration, metadata index and early-deletion fees are not included.

inputs.label: Write operations
inputs.help: Write operations per month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Read operations
inputs.help: Read operations per month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Data retrieval
inputs.help: Data read back from Cool, Cold or Archive per month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and armRegionName eq '{region}' and productName eq 'General Block Blob v2 Hierarchical Namespace'

retrieval.free: No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.
No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.
No data retrieval charge on the Hot tier.

types.label: Azure Files (pay-as-you-go)
types.note: Standard file shares billed on used capacity and transactions. Snapshots, metadata and list operations, Azure File Sync and geo-redundant shares are not included.

inputs.label: Write operations
inputs.help: Write operations per month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Read operations
inputs.help: Read operations per month, in tens of thousands.

inputs.label: Data retrieval
inputs.help: Data read back from Cool, Cold or Archive per month.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and armRegionName eq '{region}' and productName eq 'Files v2'

retrieval.free: No data retrieval charge on this tier.
No data retrieval charge on this tier.
No data retrieval charge on this tier.
No data retrieval charge on this tier.

types.label: Azure Files (provisioned v2)
types.note: You provision storage, IOPS and throughput for the share. A formula adds a free IOPS and throughput amount to the provisioned storage: enter only IOPS and MiB/s you provision above that.

inputs.label: Extra IOPS
inputs.help: Provisioned IOPS above the included amount.

inputs.label: Extra throughput
inputs.help: Provisioned throughput above the included amount.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and armRegionName eq '{region}' and productName eq 'Azure Files Provisioned v2'

types.label: Queue Storage
types.note: Classic Queue Storage pricing (the Retail API also lists a Queues v2 meter set at about ten times the transaction price; it is not used until Microsoft documents which accounts it applies to).

inputs.label: Operations
inputs.help: Queue operations per month, in tens of thousands.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and armRegionName eq '{region}' and productName eq 'Queues'

types.label: Table Storage
types.note: Capacity and read and write transactions. All transaction types carry the same price.

inputs.label: Operations
inputs.help: Table operations per month, in tens of thousands.

retail.filter: serviceName eq 'Storage' and armRegionName eq '{region}' and productName eq 'Tables'
